_: Planted red/green controls linked by GROUP marker to the two spawned tests that already drove the guard's exit code before this file existed.

mutations.find: process.exit(2) // Exit code 2 = block the tool call
mutations.replace: process.exit(0) // Exit code 2 = block the tool call
expectRed: blocks a code-reviewer brief carrying an extra CONTEXT line with exit 2 and a BLOCKED stderr
blocks a round that is not digits or "after-loop" (e.g. "2a") with exit 2
blocks a branch containing a space with exit 2
blocks a branch containing a newline with exit 2
blocks implementation-critic when the plan file does not exist on disk with exit 2
blocks implementation-critic when the plan path contains ".." with exit 2
blocks implementation-critic when the plan path is outside .work and .spec-workflow/specs with exit 2
blocks implementation-critic when the plan path contains ".." that collapses to an existing file with exit 2
blocks code-review-skill without isolation: worktree with exit 2
blocks code-review-skill with model "sonnet" with exit 2
blocks a brief whose PR number has no hash sign with exit 2
blocks code-review-skill when its two {branch} occurrences disagree with exit 2
blocks a code-reviewer brief dispatched with isolation: "worktree" with exit 2
blocks an implementation-critic brief dispatched with isolation: "worktree" with exit 2
blocks a brief whose branch is not a local branch with exit 2
blocks a steered brief padded with trailing-whitespace runs within the timeout
blocks a steered brief for a templated type pipeline.json gives no gate role
mutations.note: Forces the block() branch to exit 0 instead of 2 — a mismatched brief is logged as BLOCKED on stderr but no longer stops the tool call. Reddens every test asserting exit 2, not only the control.

expectRed: allows an exact code-reviewer brief with exit 0
allows a non-gated subagent_type with any prompt
allows general-purpose with any prompt
allows code-reviewer's exact template brief with exit 0
allows semantic-reviewer's exact template brief with exit 0
allows deletion-reviewer's exact template brief with exit 0
allows doc-updater's exact template brief with exit 0
allows red-team's exact template brief with exit 0
allows coderabbit-sync's exact template brief with exit 0
allows test-writer's exact template brief with exit 0
allows implementation-critic's exact template brief with exit 0
allows code-review-skill's exact template brief with exit 0
allows code-review-skill with model omitted (undefined defaults to opus)
allows a brief with PR none and round after-loop
allows implementation-critic with a valid existing plan when stdin cwd points elsewhere
allows a code-reviewer brief with isolation omitted
allows implementation-critic from a linked worktree when the plan exists only in the main checkout
allows an ungated type when a gated type lacks its template
mutations.note: Forces the allow() path to exit 2 instead of 0 — every non-blocked brief (the exact-match control, every gated type's own exact brief, and every non-gated type) is blocked too.

expectRed: blocks implementation-critic when the plan path is outside .work and .spec-workflow/specs with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables planPathValid's format regex only — a plan outside .work/.spec-workflow/specs (but real, no '..') is no longer rejected on that basis. The '..' test and the missing-file test still fail via their own checks and stay green.

expectRed: blocks implementation-critic when the plan path contains ".." that collapses to an existing file with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables planPathValid's explicit '..' check only. The pre-existing '..' test still blocks via the exists-on-disk check after path.join collapses its traversal to a nonexistent path, so only the fixture whose collapsed path exists goes red.

expectRed: blocks implementation-critic when the plan file does not exist on disk with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables planPathValid's exists-on-disk check only — a well-formed plan path with no '..' is accepted even when the file is missing.

expectRed: blocks code-review-skill when its two {branch} occurrences disagree with exit 2
mutations.note: Replaces the backreference for a repeated placeholder with an independent match on the same character class — the two {branch} occurrences in code-review-skill's template no longer have to agree.

expectRed: blocks code-review-skill without isolation: worktree with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables the code-review-skill isolation:worktree check only — a valid model with isolation omitted is no longer blocked on that basis.

expectRed: blocks code-review-skill with model "sonnet" with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables the code-review-skill model check only — isolation:worktree with a non-opus model is no longer blocked on that basis.

expectRed: blocks a code-reviewer brief dispatched with isolation: "worktree" with exit 2
blocks an implementation-critic brief dispatched with isolation: "worktree" with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables the non-code-review-skill worktree-forbidden check only — a gated type other than code-review-skill dispatched with isolation: "worktree" is no longer blocked on that basis.

expectRed: blocks a steered brief padded past 1MB with exit 2
mutations.note: Oversize payload exits 0 — a steered brief padded past 1MB bypasses the template check.

expectRed: blocks a brief whose branch is not a local branch with exit 2
mutations.note: A {branch} that is not a local branch is no longer blocked.

expectRed: blocks a steered brief padded with trailing-whitespace runs within the timeout
mutations.note: A backtracking trailing-whitespace regex runs past the hook timeout on a padded prompt.

expectRed: allows implementation-critic from a linked worktree when the plan exists only in the main checkout
mutations.note: A {plan} present only in the main checkout is rejected from a linked worktree.

expectRed: blocks every gated brief with exit 2 when the templates file has no templates object
mutations.note: A templates file with no templates object lets every brief through.

expectRed: blocks a gated type with exit 2 when its template is missing
mutations.note: A gated type dropped from gate-briefs.json is treated as ungated.

expectRed: allows a non-gated subagent_type with any prompt
allows general-purpose with any prompt
blocks every gated brief with exit 2 when the templates file is unparseable
allows an ungated type when a gated type lacks its template
blocks an untemplated type when pipeline.json is unreadable
mutations.note: The template checks run for every subagent_type, so an ungated dispatch is blocked.

expectRed: blocks a steered brief for a templated type pipeline.json gives no gate role
mutations.note: Only pipeline.json roles gate, so a templated type pipeline.json gives no gate role is allowed unchecked.

expectRed: blocks a round that is not digits or "after-loop" (e.g. "2a") with exit 2
mutations.note: {round} accepts any non-space token, so free text reaches the brief's round slot.

expectRed: blocks a brief whose PR number has no hash sign with exit 2
mutations.note: {pr} accepts a bare number, so the template's #N form is no longer enforced.

expectRed: blocks every gated brief with exit 2 when the templates file is unparseable
blocks an untemplated type when pipeline.json is unreadable
mutations.note: With pipeline.json unreadable, a gated type whose template is also missing reads as ungated and is allowed.
